## Motivation

A pool combining full attention, sliding-window attention and recurrent state needs the same recurrent host layout and attention-parallel metadata as the other hybrid host stacks.

## Changes

- Share recurrent host-layout selection between hybrid stack builders.
- Select direct state storage for split-KV host layouts.
- Forward attention tensor/context-parallel groups when assembling the full/window/state host stack.

## Validation

At downstream `ca400c908c`, assembler coverage passed **43 tests**. Transfer comparison across **eight configurations** showed the intended attention-group changes; unsupported state layouts failed on both sides.

Later per-tip four-chain replay had **0 divergences**, and CPU host-layout selection passed. These are combined downstream and CPU results; attention TP/CP HiCache was not validated on distributed hardware.

+def _state_host_layout() -> str:
+    # MambaPoolHost only supports page_first_direct; the global layout may be
+    # page_first_kv_split (e.g. MLA + KDA hybrid on NPU). The Mamba/KDA state
+    # pool has no separate K/V buffers, so kv_split does not apply; override
+    # to page_first_direct.
+    layout = get_memory().hicache_mem_layout
+    return "page_first_direct" if layout == "page_first_kv_split" else layout
+

+class TestMambaSwaStackMatchesOtherStacks(CustomTestCase):
+    """The full + window + state stack builds its controller and state host the
+    way the full + window and full + state stacks do."""
+
+    def test_passes_the_attention_groups(self):
+        params = SimpleNamespace(
+            token_to_kv_pool_allocator=SimpleNamespace(
+                state=SimpleNamespace(pool=object())
+            ),
+            tp_cache_group=object(),
+            pp_cache_group=object(),
+            attn_cp_cache_group=object(),
+            attn_tp_cache_group=object(),
+        )
+        kvcache = SimpleNamespace(
+            layers_mapping={0: (0, False), 1: (0, True)},
+            start_layer=0,
+            full_kv_pool=object(),
+            swa_kv_pool=object(),
+        )
+        with patch.object(
+            hybrid_pool_assembler,
+            "build_hybrid_mamba_swa_stack",
+            return_value=(MagicMock(), MagicMock()),
+        ) as build:
+            _MambaSwaStrategy().build(
+                cache=SimpleNamespace(page_size=1),
+                kvcache=kvcache,
+                params=params,
+                server_args=None,
+                load_cache_event=None,
+            )
+        kwargs = build.call_args.kwargs
+        self.assertIs(kwargs["attn_cp_group"], params.attn_cp_cache_group)
+        self.assertIs(kwargs["attn_tp_group"], params.attn_tp_cache_group)
+
+    def test_state_host_has_no_kv_split(self):
+        for layout, expected in (
+            ("page_first_kv_split", "page_first_direct"),
+            ("page_first", "page_first"),
+        ):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(layout=layout),
+                patch.object(
+                    hybrid_pool_assembler,
+                    "get_memory",
+                    return_value=SimpleNamespace(hicache_mem_layout=layout),
+                ),
+            ):
+                self.assertEqual(hybrid_pool_assembler._state_host_layout(), expected)
+
+
